story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Founded in 2010 in Suzhou Industrial Park, DENIXE CNC Technology Co., Ltd. has dedicated itself to advancing high-end CNC machining center technology.
story.p2: With over 30 patents and ISO 9001:2015 certification, our machines meet VDI 3441 geometric accuracy standards — the same benchmarks used by German machine tool builders.
story.p3: Our engineering team brings decades of experience from leading machine tool companies, combining German design philosophy with Suzhou's world-class manufacturing ecosystem.
